info.title: VenoAPI
info.description: Machine readable OpenAPI contract for VenoAPI consumer and operational endpoints.

get.description: Lightweight health endpoint used for uptime checks and deployment validation.
Returns official and share pipeline health, latest sync state, and reading lag metrics.
Pushes status updates for dashboards and monitoring clients.
Returns one official reading in mmol/L and mg/dL with trend and status.
Returns a bounded history window with ordering metadata.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp. Defaults to 24h lookback.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max points returned. Clamped by HISTORY_MAX_LIMIT.

get.description: Primary low latency glucose endpoint for realtime consumer UIs.
Share source history for recent monitoring windows and charting.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp. Defaults to 24h lookback.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max points returned. Clamped by SHARE_HISTORY_MAX_LIMIT.

get.description: Returns latest non glucose official event payload mapped from Dexcom.
Returns event stream history with date window and pagination limit.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp. Defaults to 30 day lookback.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max events returned. Clamped by EVENTS_HISTORY_MAX_LIMIT.

get.description: Machine readable OpenAPI contract for consumer and operational endpoints.
Machine readable context contract used by dashboard and AI tooling.
Returns merged official and share time in range summaries for common windows.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Supported windows: 3d, 7d, 14d, 30d, 90d. Defaults to 14d.

get.summary: List step buckets for caller API key
get.description: Returns stored health step buckets scoped to the calling consumer API key.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp for bucket filtering.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp for bucket filtering.

post.description: Stores or updates step buckets for the calling consumer API key.

get.summary: List workouts for caller API key
get.description: Returns stored workout sessions scoped to the calling consumer API key.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp for overlap filtering.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp for overlap filtering.

post.description: Stores or updates workout sessions for the calling consumer API key.

get.description: Returns Tandem basal delivery history for chart overlays and pump analysis.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp. Defaults to 24h lookback.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max points returned.

get.description: Returns Tandem pump events such as boluses, resumes, suspends, and carbs.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp. Defaults to 24h lookback.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max events returned.

get.description: Returns active shared timers and the current server time.

post.description: Creates a shared timer and publishes timer started notifications.

delete.description: Removes a shared timer and publishes timer removed notifications.

get.description: Realtime stream for shared timer lifecycle events.

post.description: Creates a notification event consumed by all connected clients.

get.description: Fetches notification events for replay and cursor bootstrap.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO timestamp lower bound for event filtering.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max events returned. Clamped by NOTIFICATIONS_HISTORY_MAX_LIMIT.

get.description: Realtime notification feed with optional sequence cursor.

parameters.name: afterSeq
parameters.description: Start streaming events after this sequence number.

get.description: Returns global profile settings used by all consumer applications.

put.description: Updates global profile settings and triggers settings.profile.updated notification.

get.description: Realtime glucose updates from official, share, or both sources.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: official, share, or both. Defaults to both.

get.description: Admin only endpoint that creates OAuth state and redirects to Dexcom consent.
Validates state, exchanges code, stores encrypted tokens, then redirects to dashboard or returns JSON success.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: OAuth authorization code from Dexcom.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: OAuth state generated by /api/auth/start.

get.description: Returns active API key metadata for admin management.

post.description: Creates new client API key. Secret is returned once in this response.
Revokes an API key by id so it can no longer authenticate.

get.description: Same list output as /api/admin/keys, used by dashboard clients.

post.description: Same create output as /api/admin/keys, used by dashboard clients.

get.description: Admin endpoint returning shared profile payload for dashboard clients.

put.description: Admin update endpoint. Persists table row and emits settings.profile.updated.

get.description: Returns the persisted VenoDashboard settings document for one dashboard uid. VenoDashboard calls this server side with admin auth and falls back to built in JSON when a document is not found.

parameters.name: dashboardUid
parameters.description: Dashboard uid, for example overview or statistics.

401.description: The request did not include admin authentication.

403.description: The request included admin authentication that did not match server configuration.

404.description: No persisted dashboard settings document exists for the requested dashboard uid.

put.description: Persists the complete VenoDashboard settings document for one dashboard uid. The document contains content and layout in the Veno dashboard schema so it can be copied or restored as JSON.

parameters.name: dashboardUid
parameters.description: Dashboard uid. Must match dashboard.spec.uid in the request body.

401.description: The request did not include admin authentication.

403.description: The request included admin authentication that did not match server configuration.

409.description: The expectedVersion value did not match the current stored version.

error.message: Dashboard settings changed before this save.

422.description: The body failed schema validation, the path dashboard uid did not match the document uid, or the layout referenced a missing element.

get.description: Returns every dashboard available for public viewing, including built in and user created dashboards.
Returns one public dashboard definition by uid.

parameters.name: dashboardUid
parameters.description: Dashboard uid, for example overview, statistics, or a user created dashboard uid.

404.description: No dashboard exists for the requested uid.

get.description: Returns public dashboard navigation preferences, including home and pinned dashboard uids.

post.description: Creates an empty live or time range dashboard. Dashboard type is immutable after creation.

422.description: The title or immutable dashboard type was missing or invalid.

patch.description: Updates dashboard title while keeping uid and type unchanged.

parameters.name: dashboardUid
parameters.description: Dashboard uid to rename.

404.description: No dashboard exists for the requested uid.

409.description: The expected version did not match the current stored dashboard version.

delete.description: Deletes a dashboard and removes it from pinned preferences. The current home dashboard and final dashboard cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: dashboardUid
parameters.description: Dashboard uid to delete.

404.description: No dashboard exists for the requested uid.

409.description: The dashboard is the selected home dashboard or is the final remaining dashboard.

get.description: Returns persisted dashboard preferences for admin management screens.

put.description: Persists home dashboard and pinned dashboard order.

422.description: The home or pinned dashboard uid does not exist.

get.summary: Read all stored health step buckets
get.description: Admin only endpoint that returns aggregated step buckets across all API keys.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp for bucket filtering.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp for bucket filtering.

get.description: Admin only endpoint that returns workout sessions across all API keys.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO start timestamp for overlap filtering.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO end timestamp for overlap filtering.

post.description: Admin only endpoint that creates a manual workout session. Overlapping workout intervals are rejected, but exact boundary touch is allowed.

put.description: Admin only endpoint that updates manual workouts directly and stores local overrides for imported workouts.

delete.description: Admin only endpoint that deletes a manual workout session. Imported workouts remain read only in this endpoint.

get.description: Runs Dexcom official sync, writes readings and events, and enqueues webhook deliveries.
Runs Dexcom Share sync, writes readings, and enqueues share webhook deliveries.
Claims pending webhook jobs, delivers them, retries failures with backoff, and updates sync run delivery stats.
Runs Tandem sync immediately when the backend decides a fresh sync is warranted.
